newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD plummets 6.47 pct on disappointment.
newsitem.headline: CVRD plummets 6.47 pct on disappointment.

text.p: Preferred shares of Cia Vale do Rio Doce dropped 6.47 percent by midday on profit-taking amid some disappointment the company's privatization auction Tuesday did not draw a higher premium, traders said.
"People were expecting this auction to be a little more aggressive and they expected a higher premium," said Pedro Sutter of Banco Tendencia.

The share plunged to 26.00 reais by 1230 local time/1130 EDT on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange on strong trade of 20 million reais ($18.8 million). The broader bolsa was down 0.76 percent at 10,141 points on profit-taking.
